mapper.select: SELECT coupon_type_code AS couponTypeCode, coupon_name AS couponName, default_discount_type AS defaultDiscountType, default_discount_value AS defaultDiscountValue, default_min_order_amount AS defaultMinOrderAmount, valid_days AS validDays, description, is_active AS isActive FROM COUPON_TEMPLATE WHERE coupon_type_code = #{couponTypeCode} AND is_active = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND coupon_type_code = 'WELCOME'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND coupon_type_code = 'BDAY' AND TO_CHAR(issued_at, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND coupon_type_code = 'MONTHLY_GRADE' AND TO_CHAR(issued_at, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')

SELECT user_no AS userNo, role, userId, userPwd, addr, name, phone, phone_verified, email, email_verified, email_verify_token, email_verify_expired_at, birth, gender, photo, last_login_at, created_date, updated_date, is_blocked, block_reason, blocked_at FROM USERS WHERE birth IS NOT NULL AND TO_CHAR(birth, 'MMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MMDD') AND NVL(is_blocked, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT um.user_no AS userNo, um.grade_code AS gradeCode FROM USER_MEMBERSHIP um JOIN USERS u ON u.user_no = um.user_no WHERE NVL(u.is_blocked, 'N') = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COUPON ( coupon_id, user_no, coupon_type_code, coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value, min_order_amount, max_discount_amount, is_first_order_only, issued_at, expires_at, used_yn, grade_code_issued_from, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{couponId}, #{userNo}, #{couponTypeCode}, #{couponName}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{minOrderAmount}, #{maxDiscountAmount}, #{firstOrderOnly}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, 'N', #{gradeCodeIssuedFrom}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT coupon_id AS couponId, coupon_name AS couponName, discount_type AS discountType, discount_value AS discountValue, min_order_amount AS minOrderAmount, TO_CHAR(expires_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS expiresAt, used_yn AS usedYn FROM COUPON WHERE user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY issued_at DESC
